name: How long does it take to install a custom media wall?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a custom media wall?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeline for a custom media wall varies based on its complexity, size, and chosen materials. Typically, after the design phase and material procurement, on-site installation can range from a few days to a couple of weeks. Process clarity suggests that unforeseen structural elements or extensive electrical work discovered during demolition can extend this timeline.
